notes: Read SKILL.md and references/apis-operations.md, references/products-subscriptions.md, references/service-management.md in full. .NET management-plane reference for Azure API Management (Azure.ResourceManager.ApiManagement): creating services, APIs, operations, versions/revisions, products, subscriptions, users, groups, policies, backup/restore, SKUs, VNet, custom domains and managed identity.

Medium only because SKILL.md:23-24 gives `dotnet add package Azure.ResourceManager.ApiManagement` and `Azure.Identity` (official NuGet packages, unpinned). All ARM calls, including DeleteAsync on APIs, subscriptions and the whole service and key regeneration, are C# sample code for the user's application using DefaultAzureCredential; the agent is not told to call Azure, read secrets, or run anything else.

SKILL.md:311 links references/policies.md, which is not present in the skill or upstream; it is an optional pointer, since SKILL.md:190-222 shows a policy example and SKILL.md:318 links the official policy reference. Samples print subscription primary/secondary keys to the console (SKILL.md:186-187, references/products-subscriptions.md:86-88) and use a literal sample password (products-subscriptions.md:134); users should not copy those into production. Service creation provisions billable resources and can take 30+ minutes.
